description: This PHP class 'LinksResponse' models a response object for JSON API links, encapsulating 'self' and 'related' URLs or references, and providing JSON serialization functionality.

classes.name: LinksResponse
classes.description: A response class for handling 'links' in a JSON API response, with properties for 'self' and 'related' links, and implements JSON serialization.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the self URL or reference.

methods.name: setSelf
methods.description: Sets the self URL or reference.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Returns the related URL or reference.

methods.name: setRelated
methods.description: Sets the related URL or reference.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JSON-compatible array, filtering out null or empty values.
